post.description: Accepts a browser CSP violation payload (`application/csp-report` or JSON with a `csp-report` object), normalizes into the shared error ring buffer as `kind: csp-violation`, and returns **204**. Tagged `csrf-exempt` because the browser cannot send our double-submit CSRF header on automatic violation posts. Tagged `no-auth` because browsers cannot rely on session cookies on automatic `report-uri` posts (no-cors).

schema.description: W3C CSP reporting body; typically includes a top-level `csp-report` object.
Some user agents send the same JSON as `application/json`.

204.description: Report accepted and stored in the error ring buffer.

code.description: A short, machine-readable error code, for when HTTP status codes are not sufficient.

message.description: A human-readable description of the error.
message.example: The requested resource could not be found.
